title: Funded large-batch extraction run (hard budget cap)
context: If donated-lane throughput is insufficient, a funded large-batch extraction run may execute via packages/runner on an Anthropic API key with a hard per-task budget cap (fundedBudgetUsd) it must never exceed, with a public cost ledger. Binding cancer guardrails apply: open-access (PMC OA Subset) / aggregate / de-identified data only; no identifiable patient data; no medical advice; provenance on every assertion. Same extraction guardrails as the donated lane apply: grounded, aggregate-only assertions, domain + License/PII sign-off. The fundedBudgetUsd value here is a placeholder cap to be confirmed when escrow is defined.
objective: Run a funded large-batch extraction (via packages/runner, hard budget cap) producing grounded, aggregate-only assertions -- only if donated throughput is insufficient.
acceptanceCriteria: Runs only via packages/runner on an Anthropic API key with a hard per-task budget cap (fundedBudgetUsd); execution never exceeds the cap.
Large-batch extraction produces only grounded, aggregate-only assertions (same guardrails as ner-014/biomarker-018); the groundedness re-location check is enforced.
A public cost ledger is recorded; the batch is engaged only if donated-lane throughput is demonstrably insufficient.
Domain reviewer and License/PII reviewer sign-off recorded, as for the equivalent donated extraction.
